what: Ameren is a regulated utility in Missouri and Illinois. It generates and delivers electricity in Missouri, delivers electricity and gas in Illinois, and owns transmission lines across the region.
customers: About 2.4 million electricity and 900,000 gas customers across Missouri and Illinois.
money: regulated electricity generation and delivery plus gas
moat: Regulated monopolies in two states, with returns set by commissions rather than by competition.
risks: Debt of about $21 billion against almost no cash
Missouri and Illinois regulators set allowed returns and have been demanding
Heavy capital spending requires continuous financing
opportunities: Revenue grew about 15% last year with a 23% operating margin
Data centre interest in Missouri is raising projected load growth
Transmission investment earns a federally regulated return
watch: Data centre connection agreements in Missouri and rate case outcomes.
